newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Sept 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Sept 18.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Egyptian President Mubarak says suspects admit that Iran was involved in the attempt to assassinate him in Addis Ababa last year.
- King Fahd urges the private sector to employ more Saudis.
- Palestinian Cement Co to set up a cement plant at a cost of $65-$100 million.
- France opens a $30 million credit line to Tunisia, develops cooperation to protect environment.
- Turkmenistan welcomes the setting up of an Islamic bank. A seminar sponsored by the Jeddah-based Islamic Development Bank has proposed the creation of an Islamic bank in the former Soviet republic.
- Saudi National Commercial Bank offers a new trust fund to invest in foreign currencies.
- Saudi's bank assets rise 1.5 percent to 272.5 billion riyals in the first half of 1996, Riyad Bank report says.
